document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You  quickly  confirm  your  discovery  of  a  redoubt  of 
unprecedented prehistoric survival. Animal tracks attributable 
to  no  modern  beast  of  the  North  abound  in  the  sand  and 
bubbly  mud;  however,  your  specialty  is  anthropology—your 
paleontological studies have been limited.

Make a Natural World roll: if you succeed, go to 269; if you fail, go 
to 275.
